cards.text: Then which of the favors of your Lord will you deny?
Indeed, He who created me will guide me.

cards.arabic: رَبِّ اجْعَلْنِي مُقِيمَ الصَّلَاةِ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِي
cards.text: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer — and from my descendants too.
Say: He is Allah, the One.
Allah is the Light of the heavens and the earth.
Allah is Gentle and loves gentleness in all things.
Kindness is not found in anything except that it adds beauty to it — and nothing is deprived of kindness except that it is disgraced.
Your smile in your brother's face is sadaqah.
The merciful are shown mercy by the Most Merciful. Be merciful to those on earth, and the One above the heavens will be merciful to you.
Every son of Adam sins, and the best of sinners are those who repent.
The most beloved deeds to Allah are the most consistent, even if small.
